about: What murrtty's Windows release (build-windows.cmd -Package) includes from others,
and where each license text comes from; the package's THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt is
written from it. A text's 'from' is 'repo' (this repository), 'zig' (the Zig
toolchain the build used) or '<zon folder>:<dependency>', a dependency of
build.zig.zon (folder '') or of pkg/<name>/build.zig.zon, read from zig-pkg/.
'start' and 'end' (inclusive) or 'until' (exclusive) cut a text to the lines
between the first ones containing them. A component's 'pinFiles' are repository
files its version comes from, pinned by SHA-256 in 'filePins'; '{zig}' in a
version is the Zig version the build used. Packaging fails while any fetched
dependency (of the repository's build.zig.zon files, or of a covered
dependency's own, keyed '<its key>/<name>') is neither covered by a component
nor excluded, while a covered one's hash differs from 'pins' or a pinned file
changed (check its license and version again, then update the pin), or while a
key is named that nothing has.
